title: Trumpet players trying to out-blow each other in the brass bands
summary: Brass-band players competed, with Rene's brother and Ricard going head to head. Rene criticises over-hard playing.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, would they have battles between the different musicians in that one brass band, you know, contests like?

Oh, they would sometimes be trying to out blow on none of them. Yeah. Yeah, they'd try to out blow on none of them. See the second lines, you know, they, well they know how my brother could go up in there, you know. And any other trumpet player could play good like Ricard and them fellas like that, you know.
He'd be like, look out Ricard, look out Ricard. All right there, Rene, go upstairs.

And he had no better sense, you see, just going and playing. That fellow overplayed himself, you know, played too much, you know. They played too hard, sometimes they'd be too tired, man, at night, you know. All that hard playing is not necessary. Them fellas don't do that. I noticed they work together now, I know, I be watching them close, they work together now, man. But them other fellas look like this, boy, seesawing, boy, just rocking one fella. One fella let out a fella take a chorus, man, when he get ready to take that chorus, he threw his horn up in there. They kind of had a little friction there and iron there, but none of them was too hot, you know. Of course they got that swing, all right.
